metadata.description: 🏦 给 DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 的每次任务加一条预算线。支持按金额或 Token 限制消耗、自动拦截/手动放行，防止 Agent 过度消费。 🏦 Draws a budget line across every task in DSH (DeepSeek Harness). Cap consumption by CNY or token count, with auto-interception and burn-rate estimates to prevent runaway costs.
